blocks.text: Thank you: the outstanding cost schedules reached us this morning, so we now have what we need for the working session on the {{fact:f:E-2009-003.client}} integration. Ahead of it, we have gathered the early findings into a short briefing deck, which I will send under separate cover for your team to read before we meet. The deck lists Mary Parker and Daniel Leach as its preparers, so any question on the underlying figures can come to either of us.

Jason Torres will lead the session itself and would welcome a short conversation with you, Joseph Wallace, beforehand, to settle on the two or three decisions we believe the integration turns on before the wider group convenes.
If you can let me know a half hour that suits you and Jason Torres in the next day or two, I will hold it and send the agenda around to everyone by the end of the week.
